integrity: Proof and runnable finite checks are included; no simulated evidence is used as proof. Literature comparisons are qualified by possible unindexed equivalents.
scientific_limitations: Two distinct nonorthogonal unit rows in the real plane; consistent equations; independent fixed row sampling; exact projections; deterministic row cost; mean-square exponent divided by expected work, not fixed-time or quenched performance. No independent validation.
title: Sharp cost-normalized annealed sampling for two-row randomized Kaczmarz
